card.name: Platelet count thresholds in dose rules
card.fires_on: Small words, spaces or symbols right after "platelet count" or "platelets" and before the numeric cutoff, such as "less than", "equal to" or "<". It appears in dose-adjustment tables for low platelets.

modes.label: Linking words before a cutoff
modes.description: Words like "than" or "to" that sit between platelet count and the number.

modes.label: Space or symbol before the number
modes.description: A space or "<" just before a platelet value.

modes.label: Inside the word platelet
modes.description: The end of the word platelet in text about aggregation.
modes.example: no significant inhibitory effect on plate<<let>> aggregation or pharmacokinetics of aspirin

card.plain: It fires when a platelet count is about to be followed by a numeric cutoff in a dose-change rule.
